sloka: विवर्धयति पक्षम् च सुराणाम् सुर भावनः ।विषयेषु प्रसक्तेन यत् किम्चित् कारिणा त्वया ॥६-३५-१७॥।।
transliteration: vivardhayati pakṣam ca surāṇām sura bhāvanaḥ ।viṣayeṣu prasaktena yat kimcit kāriṇā tvayā ॥6-35-17॥।।

translations.english: "Being engaged in matters of sense pleasures you have created great agitation(disturbance) in the minds of the seers (engaged in penance) who resemble gods of burning fire."
